name: Razer Battery
description:
Razer wireless device battery in the top panel, deduped by device.

Features:
- Live battery percentage for every connected Razer device, with a charging marker and a theme-adaptive icon
- One entry per device: several sysfs interfaces of the same mouse (wired + dongle) are deduplicated
- Fully asynchronous sysfs reads: a sleeping mouse never blocks the shell
- Sleep-aware: the last known charge is held while the device sleeps
- Instant hotplug reaction via a filesystem watch
- Low-battery notification with a configurable threshold (5-50%)
- Zero overhead when the OpenRazer driver is missing: dormant mode, single '!' in the panel

Requires the OpenRazer kernel driver. If it's missing, the indicator shows '!' and the menu offers a one-command guided install (Arch and derivatives, Fedora, Ubuntu, Debian, openSUSE). Nothing privileged runs inside the shell. A reboot is required after install - the kernel module loads at boot.

Tested on Arch Linux, GNOME Shell 50, OpenRazer 3.12.4, Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K. Other mice supported by OpenRazer should work out of the box.

Found a bug? Please report it on GitHub.
